features.name: enclosed rectangular field
features.quote: The arena should be an enclosed rectangular field with outer walls on all four sides.

features.name: open battlefield layout
features.notes: One large contiguous map with dispersed cover points rather than defined lanes
features.quote: One large contiguous map with dispersed points of interest instead of defined lanes.

features.name: central dividing barrier
features.notes: Large barrier in the middle of the field

features.name: central pinch point gaps
features.notes: Gaps at either end of the central barrier
features.quote: The gaps at either end of the large central dividing barrier

features.name: mirrored cover blocks
features.notes: Multiple symmetric blocks on both field halves
features.quote: multiple symmetric cover blocks on both halves

features.name: tactical cover arrays
features.notes: Evenly distributed and mirrored; waist-high and full-body barriers
features.quote: Waist-high and full-body paintball barriers in bright, playful colours distributed evenly across the field and mirrored between the two halves

features.name: scattered small cover
features.notes: Smaller elements distributed around the field

features.name: elevated sniper platforms
features.notes: One mirrored platform on each half

features.name: exposed platform ramps
features.notes: Ramps are the only visible access to each elevated platform
features.quote: reachable only by exposed ramps, one mirrored on each half

features.name: opposing team bases
features.notes: Mirrored at the two short ends of the field and shielded from long sniper sightlines
features.quote: Mirrored team bases at the two short ends of the field, shielded from sniper lines down the arena.

features.name: bright playful barriers
features.quote: Use a paintball arena aesthetic with colorful barriers.
